kanjivg-hiragana.js holds stroke order data taken from KanjiVG (release r20260714).

KanjiVG: https://kanjivg.tagaini.net/  (source: https://github.com/KanjiVG/kanjivg)
Copyright (C) 2009-2026 Ulrich Apel.

KanjiVG is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0 licence.
kanjivg-hiragana.js is an adaptation of it (only the stroke paths and stroke number positions
were kept, unchanged), and is shared under the same licence:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
